name: maybe_Snd_ShutdownEngine
signature: void maybe_Snd_ShutdownEngine(void* engine, u32 arg2, u32* mask, int count)
summary: Stops the sound engine: marks f_358/f_348, waits on and closes the session handle at f_344, releases the command buffer at f_340, then walks a caller-supplied bitmask and releases each set 0x1C-byte voice record at f_24 + i*0x1C.
evidence: Callees (0x0010DF40/0x0010DF90, Snd_ReleaseAllChannels) and the voice-record bitmask fit 'release these voices', but Ghidra lost unaff_r5/r6/r8/r11 and the Thumb body has overlapping instructions, so whole-engine shutdown vs per-call release is still open.

name: maybe_Snd_StreamManager_ServiceSlots
signature: void maybe_Snd_StreamManager_ServiceSlots(void* self, u32 arg2, int count)
summary: Services pending stream slots under the sound command-queue mutex, completing streams and releasing channels; only caller is Snd_StreamManager_Update, but the body is heavily damaged (software_interrupt, extraout_r1) so the exact slot semantics stay uncertain.
evidence: Caller Snd_StreamManager_Update; callees Os_MutexLock, Snd_ReleaseAllChannels, Fs_SubmitAsyncTransfer; body has damaged decompilation (software_interrupt 0x24/0x14, extraout_r1).

name: maybe_Applet_AckSuspendState
summary: Takes the GPU command-queue lock, either clears f_12 or marks the current 0x1C-byte slot entry ready and sets f_18, then unlocks; called after present and file-job updates, so it is a per-frame queue/slot acknowledgement whose exact meaning (suspend vs transition) is unproven.
evidence: Callers Gfx_Display_PresentFrame, Fs_FileJob_Update, Fs_FileJob_UpdateAlt; callee Gfx_WriteHwRegsMasked; body touches g_gpuCommandQueueManager f_a0/f_11/f_12/f_18 and slot stride 0x1c.

name: maybe_Snd_InitStreamContext
summary: Creates/attaches the streaming context: opens the kernel handle, tags it, queries unit count, sets the 0x2000 transfer buffer and resets 24 channel objects; returns 0 or a Horizon error code. No named caller confirms the context type.
evidence: No callers; callees include Snd_ResetChannelUnitsInPlace, Snd_RestoreChannelState, Os_LockMonitor/UnlockMonitor, Svc_Ndm_AcquireService; body uses 0xC8A0A801 error and 24-channel layout.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelLevel
summary: Stores a 16-bit value at channel block +0xBC and sets dirty bit 0x10000; called from Snd_InitChannelState and Snd_RestoreChannelState, so it is a saved channel-state field of unknown meaning.
evidence: Callers Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState; body strh at +0xbc and OR 0x10000 into +0xc0.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelFormat
summary: Stores a 16-bit value at channel block +0x18 and sets dirty bit 0x8000000; published by Snd_InitChannelState and replayed by Snd_RestoreChannelState, so it is a saved channel-state field (format is inference).
evidence: Callers Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState; body writes u16 at +0x18 and ORs 0x8000000.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelGain
summary: Stores a float at channel block +0x04 and sets dirty bit 0x10000; Snd_InitChannelState publishes 1.0f, so it is a gain-like scalar, though gain vs rate is unresolved.
evidence: Callers Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState, Sound_Channel_SetDecodeHook; body stores in_s0 float at +0x04 and ORs 0x10000.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelAdpcmState
signature: u32 maybe_Snd_SetChannelAdpcmState(ChannelBuffer* context, int unit, u16 value)
summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the per-unit halfword at channel+0x24+unit*2 and sets dirty bit 0x40 (unit 0) or 0x80 (unit 1); replayed per unit by Snd_RestoreChannelState, so the two-slot shape is confirmed but the ADPCM reading is inference.
evidence: Callers Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState; body writes u16 at +0x24+unit*2 and ORs 0x40/0x80.

name: maybe_Snd_SetUnitGain
signature: void maybe_Snd_SetUnitGain(ChannelBuffer* context, int unit, float gain)
summary: Stores a float in the per-unit field at channel+0x08+unit*4 and sets dirty bit 0x1000000 (unit 0) or 0x2000000 (unit 1); Snd_InitChannelState publishes 1.0f for both units, so these are per-unit gain scalars.
evidence: Callers Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState, Sound_Channel_InvokeCallback; body stores in_s0 float at puVar2[unit+2] and ORs 0x1000000/0x2000000.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelVolume
summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the channel block's field at +0x10 and sets dirty bit 0x8000. Snd_InitChannelState publishes 2 here and the restore path replays the saved state word f_32, so it is a channel-state field; the volume reading is still an inference.
evidence: Called by Snd_InitChannelState, Snd_RestoreChannelState and Snd_SetOutputMode; writes u16 at +0x10 and sets dirty bit 0x8000. Field is confirmed saved channel state, but a default of 2 does not prove it is volume.

name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelOutput
signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelOutput(ChannelBuffer* context, unsigned int outputSelect)
summary: Writes the channel's output/bus selector (value must be < 2) at +0x1e and marks it dirty (bit 0x40000000).
evidence: Only branch target is 0x00112D60 inside Snd_RestoreChannelState, which replays saved byte f_27 through it; the '< 2' guard plus a single two-valued field is the only argument for reading it as an output selector.
